name: The Calile Hotel
lede: Seven private cabanas line the pool deck of The Calile, Brisbane’s urban resort hotel on James Street. Each has its own power, a ceiling fan and an overhead Bromic heater that guests control from inside.
data: Urban resort hotel – seven pool-deck cabanas
Guest-controlled in each cabana; control to confirm

hero.caption: The pool deck and its cabanas. Bromic-published photograph from the case study.

beats: Developed by Michael and Cal Malouf, The Calile is a high-end urban resort designed around the guest experience, with seven private cabanas along its pool deck.
Each cabana was to be a private, self-contained retreat, with comfort the guest can set for themselves.
Every cabana has private power, a USB charging point, a ceiling fan and an overhead Bromic heater, controlled by the guest from inside.

products.name: Platinum Smart-Heat® Electric
products.controls: Guests control it from inside the cabana; the control is not named
